id: title:Gilbert09:stop retrying a supavisor user that does not exist

review.posthog_relevance: Supavisor ingestion connection handling and retry behavior
review.reason: Adds three permanent and transient error classifications to Postgres connection handling, distinguishing credential/database identity failures from transient connection issues. This supports correct retry behavior and prevents unnecessary retry loops or circuit-breaker trips in the ingestion system.
review.uncertainty: The tier is assigned based on the implementation of bounded capability and correctness improvement. The actual benefit of preventing circuit-breaker trips or avoiding unnecessary retries is not independently verified by the code, only the implementation of the classification is visible. No adoption or incident avoidance is inferred.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, cohesive change group. No unrelated PRs detected. No missing context. No abstention.

observations.behavior: Adds two permanent, non-retryable error classifications to Postgres connection error handling.
observations.posthog_connection: These classifications distinguish permanent credential/database identity failures from transient connection issues, preventing unnecessary retry loops and Supavisor circuit-breaker trips.

observations.behavior: Adds a transient, retryable error classification for Supavisor's auth_query timeout.

observations.posthog_connection: Allows the ingestion system to distinguish between a temporary authentication query timeout and permanent credential failures, supporting correct retry behavior.

observations.behavior: Adds a permanent, non-retryable error classification for Supavisor's credential-fetch circuit breaker, including nested EAUTHQUERY details.
